full_prompt_en: A square faded color street photograph shows an elderly man in a dark brimmed hat and heavy coat on a quiet winter road. He fills the right foreground from the upper chest upward, his body turned away while his weathered face looks back toward the camera. The face carries warm muted red in the cheeks, deep eye shadows, a gray moustache, and a full pale beard. A thin cigarette projects from the mouth toward the left, and his expression remains guarded and unsmiling. The dark felt hat makes a rounded horizontal shape above the face; the coat collar rises around his neck and spreads into a broad brown-black mass across the lower right. Behind him, the road extends into misty distance. On the left, bare branches and a vertical fence form fine dark marks. Near the middle of the street, a small bundled pedestrian moves away, softened by the haze. Utility poles and overhead wires draw thin lines across the washed-out sky, while low buildings line the right background. The colors are visibly aged: greenish cyan in the sky and distance, pale yellow around the upper right, rust-red light leaks around the corners, and muted brown in the street and coat. Tiny white specks, scratches, and uneven fading remain across the print. Soft diffuse daylight comes through the mist and lights the man's face from the front-left without a firm shadow; more of his coat merges into the subdued foreground. The foreground face remains clearer than the small street details, but even it has a softened, timeworn photographic edge. There is no readable text. The overall composition is candid and slightly off center, using a close human gaze against a receding ordinary street and visibly weathered color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形褪色彩色街头照片呈现一名戴深色有檐帽、穿厚外套的老人，站在安静的冬日道路上。他从胸部上方占据右侧前景，身体转开，风霜满面的脸却回望镜头。脸颊带低饱和暖红，眼周深影，留着灰色上唇胡和浓密的浅色胡须。一根细香烟从嘴角向左伸出，神情戒备而不带笑意。深色毡帽在脸上方形成圆润的水平形状；外套衣领围住颈部，并在右下铺成宽阔的棕黑色体量。身后道路伸入雾蒙蒙的远方。左侧，光秃树枝与一道竖向栅栏构成细密暗痕。街道中部附近，一名裹着衣服的小行人向远方走去，被雾气柔化。电线杆与高架电线在褪色天空上画出细线，低矮楼房沿右侧后景排列。颜色明显老化：天空和远处呈偏绿青色，右上方有浅黄，角落有锈红色漏光，街道与外套则为低饱和棕色。微小白点、刮痕和不均褪色留在整张照片上。柔和漫射日光穿过雾气，从左前方照亮老人的脸，没有明确硬影；外套更多地融入低调前景。前景面孔比小小的街道细节清楚，但其边缘也有柔化、历经时间的摄影感。画面没有可读文字。整体构图抓拍且略偏中心，以贴近的人物目光对照后退的日常街道和可见的风化色彩。
style_prompt_en: The aged color-photographic style uses muted cyan-green, dusty amber, faded brown, and restrained rust-red rather than clean modern saturation. Broad soft haze lowers contrast through the distance, while a nearer dark mass remains substantial and slightly textured. Scratches, small pale specks, irregular fading, and warm edge leaks stay visible as part of the print surface. Diffuse ambient light gently models forms without crisp cast shadows, and thin linear details drift into mist. A close offset focal area is balanced against a long receding field with quiet everyday geometry. Warm and cool stains overlap imperfectly, giving the image a remembered, timeworn character. The overall effect is candid, melancholic, and tactile, with faded color and physical film wear carrying much of the mood.
style_prompt_zh: 这种老化彩色摄影风格使用低饱和青绿、灰黄、褪色棕和克制的锈红，而非洁净的现代高饱和色。大片柔雾降低远方反差，较近处的深色体量仍然厚重且略有肌理。刮痕、细小浅色斑点、不规则褪色和边缘暖色漏光作为照片表面的一部分保留下来。漫射环境光轻轻塑造形体，没有清晰硬投影，细线状细节逐渐漂入雾中。偏在一侧的贴近焦点区与漫长后退、几何平静的空间取得平衡。暖色与冷色污痕不完全吻合地重叠，使图像带有回忆般的历时感。整体效果抓拍、忧郁且可触，褪色与真实胶片磨损承担大部分气氛。
